sloka: तेन सुग्रीववाक्येन सावमानेन मानितः।अग्नेराज्याहुतस्येव तेजस्तस्याभ्यवर्धत।ततः कुम्भस्तु सुग्रीवं बाहुभ्यां जगृहे तदा ।। ६.७६.८१ ।।
transliteration: tena sugrīvavākyena sāvamānena mānitaḥ।agnerājyāhutasyeva tejastasyābhyavardhata।tataḥ kumbhastu sugrīvaṁ bāhubhyāṁ jagṛhe tadā ।। 6.76.81 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva's words of flattering royalty captivated Kumbha's fire of energy, which doubled like fire fed with ghee.
